title: Bacc. Arith.
html_source:
Baccalaureatus (Bachelor) of Arithmetic? No good source could be found, but it agrees with “both natality and mortality…everything…is subject to a law of numeration as yet unascertained.”

Interesting etymology:
From French baccalauréat or medieval Latin baccalaureatus, from baccalaureus ‘bachelor.’ The earlier form baccalarius was altered by wordplay to conform with bacca lauri ‘laurel berry,’ because of the laurels awarded to scholars.
